answer:
Simulation type: 3D transient multi-phase CFD of gravity-driven sloshing in a rectangular tank using the interFoam solver in OpenFOAM.
Tank geometry: a rectangular box with dimensions x = 1.0 m (length, sloshing direction), y = 0.6 m (height, gravity direction), z = 0.1 m (width).
Gravity vector: (0, -9.81, 0) pointing in the negative y-direction, defined in constant/g.
Fluid phases: water (rho = 1000 kg/m3, nu = 1e-6 m2/s) as phase 1 (alpha.water) and air (rho = 1.0 kg/m3, nu = 1.5e-5 m2/s) as phase 2. Surface tension sigma = 0.0728 N/m defined in constant/transportProperties.
Initial condition: water depth varies linearly along x from 0.25 m at x=0 to 0.35 m at x=1 (mean depth approximately 0.30 m, consistent with half-filled in a 0.6 m tall tank). The interface is built as a 10-slice staircase in setFieldsDict with boxToCell regions. Slice i (0-indexed) spans x in [0.1*i, 0.1*(i+1)] and is filled to height h = 0.255 + 0.01*i in the y-direction. Inside each region alpha.water = 1, outside = 0. Initial velocity U = (0,0,0) and p_rgh = 0 everywhere.
Mesh: single blockMesh block with 200 cells in x, 120 cells in y, 20 cells in z (hex 200 120 20). Total domain is the full tank. No empty patches. All six faces are named as boundary patches: leftWall (x=0), rightWall (x=1), bottom (y=0), top (y=0.6), frontWall (z=0), backWall (z=0.1).
Boundary conditions on top (y=0.6, open to atmosphere): U = pressureInletOutletVelocity, p_rgh = totalPressure with p0 = 0, alpha.water = inletOutlet with inletValue 0.
Boundary conditions on leftWall (x=0), rightWall (x=1), bottom (y=0), frontWall (z=0), backWall (z=0.1): U = noSlip, p_rgh = fixedFluxPressure, alpha.water = zeroGradient. All five are treated identically as solid no-slip walls.
Temporal control in system/controlDict: startTime 0, endTime 10, writeInterval 0.05, deltaT = 1e-3, adjustTimeStep on, maxCo 0.5, maxDeltaT set to prevent runaway growth (e.g. 0.005).
Convective and gradient schemes in system/fvSchemes: div(phi,alpha) = limitedLinear 1, div(phi,U) = limitedLinear 1, grad(p_rgh) = cellLimited Gauss linear 1. Time scheme for ddt(alpha) and ddt(U) uses Euler. Laplacian schemes use corrected Gauss linear.
Solver settings in system/fvSolution: p_rgh solved with PCG using DILU smoother (tolerance 1e-7, relTol 0.01). U solved with smoothSolver using symmetricGaussSeidel smoother (tolerance 1e-5, relTol 0.01). PISO loop with nNonOrthogonalCorrectors = 1. MULES sub-cycle settings: MULESCorr on, nLapIter 1, maxAlphaCourantNumber set appropriately (e.g. 1.0). Standard interFoam template settings are used and not altered.
Turbulence: laminar. system/turbulenceProperties contains simulationType laminar. No RAS or LES model is enabled.
Post-processing expectation: the released tilted interface oscillates back and forth under gravity restoring force with viscous damping from the no-slip walls, observable as time-varying free-surface height at left and right walls over the 10-second run.
